y-m-35-01.material:
Abafundi ababini bacombulula ulingano |x − 2| = 2x − 7 (x linani lenyani). Indlela yokufunda: '|x − 2| = 2x − 7' ngu 'ixabiso eliphelele lika-x ukhutshwe ngo-2 lilingana no-2x ukhutshwe ngo-7'. Bobabini abafundi baqala ngokwahlula kwi 'xa x ≥ 2' ne 'xa x < 2'.
· Xa x ≥ 2: ukusuka ku-x − 2 = 2x − 7, kwaphuma x = 5.
· Xa x < 2: ukusuka ku-−(x − 2) = 2x − 7, kwaphuma x = 3.
Umfundi 가 waphendula 'x = 3 okanye x = 5', kwaye umfundi 나 waphendula 'x = 5'.

y-m-35-06.title: Ukuhlola isisombululo esigqibe ukuba 'akukho sisombululo'
y-m-35-06.topic: Iinkcazelo zedigri ephezulu: imeko yokungalahlekelwa zizisombululo xa intetho enye ikumacala omabini
y-m-35-06.goal: Kwinkcazelo enentetho enye kumacala omabini, fumana apho impazamo yesisombululo iqala khona, ugwebe ukuba kweyiphi imeko ungalahlekelwa zizisombululo, uze uyile inkcazelo apho isisombululo silahlekileyo.
y-m-35-06.material: Esi sisisombululo somfundi senkcazelo (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1) (x linani lokwenyani). Indlela yokufunda: '(x − 3)(x + 2) ilingana no-(x − 3)(x + 1)'.

y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.1: Ukwahlula amacala omabini ngu-(x − 3) kunika x + 2 = x + 1.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.2: Ukwenza lula kunika 2 = 1, ngoko inkcazelo ayibambi.

Enyanisweni, ukuba ufaka x = 3, amacala omabini yi-0, ngoko x = 3 sisisombululo.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Ukuphepha ukulahlekelwa zizisombululo kwindlela yokwahlula intetho efanayo (x − 3) kumacala omabini, esiphi kwezi silandelayo esinceda? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngokuqala ukukhangela naliphi na x elenza uyahlulayo abe yi-0, uze ubone okwenzekayo xa ufaka eli xabiso kwinkcazelo yokuqala.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kwinketho nganye, cinga ukuba 'x apho isisombululo sinokulahleka' sishiyiwe okanye hayi.

y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.c: Ukuba kuphuma ukuphikisana (2 = 1) emva kokwahlula, cinga ukuba inkcazelo yokuqala nayo iyaphikisana
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.c: Inkcazelo ehlulwe kunye nenkcazelo yokuqala zisenokungabi yinkcazelo enye. Ukuphikisana sisiphumo senkcazelo ehlulwe kuphela.

y-m-35-07.title: Ukuba i-discriminant ibi, ingaba ihlala ingqina? Ukuthelekisa izisombululo ezimbini
y-m-35-07.topic: Imeko yokungalingani kwe-quadratic ukuze isebenze kuzo zonke iinani eziyi-real: i-discriminant nophawu lomlinganiselo ophambili
y-m-35-07.goal: Thelekisa uze uvavanye izisombululo ezimbini zemeko apho ibinzana le-quadratic lingqina kuzo zonke iinani eziyi-real, bonisa impazamo yesisombululo esinye ngomzekelo ochasayo, uze ubhale imeko epheleleyo.
y-m-35-07.material:
k sisiqhubekayo seqinisileyo, yaye ingxaki ithi 'Fumana uluhlu luka-k ukuze ukungalingani kx² − 4x + k > 0 kusebenze kuzo zonke iinani eziyi-real x'. Indlela yokufunda: 'k x isikwere ukususa 4x kunye k likhulu kuno-zero'.
Isisombululo A: Ukuze igrafu ihlale ingaphezulu kwe-x-axis, akufuneki idibane ne-x-axis, ngoko D/4 = 4 − k² < 0, oko kukuthi k² > 4. Ngoko k > 2 okanye k < −2.
Isisombululo B: Phakathi kwe-k > 2 okanye k < −2 efunyenwe kwi-A, igrafu kufuneka ibe ngaphezulu, ngoko k > 0 iyafuneka nayo. Ngoko k > 2.
